days_note: days: 1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, 3=Wednesday, 4=Thursday, 5=Friday, 6=Saturday, 0=Sunday. Every station has separate Monday-Friday, Saturday and Sunday entries, even when Saturday and Sunday are identical. Times are local station time in the station's timezone field. Entries never cross midnight: an overnight programme is split into a 20:00-24:00 entry and a 00:00-06:00 entry on the following day.
notes: YES 933 is the previously verified v3 (2026-11-23), copied unchanged.

melisten grids (987 / CAPITAL 958 / LOVE 972) do not print times on cells; times were read from cell edges against the hourly header. Hour boundaries are reliable, minute-level reading has about 10 minutes of uncertainty.
Entries with verified:false are template fills or boundary interpretations, not read from the official schedule. Search the file for verified:false to find every slot Evan needs to check or edit.
883 JIA and POWER 98 publish no schedule; their whole week is the station default_program from stations.json.
HitFM uses the 北部 (n1077) grid only.

This file is meant to live next to stations.json in radio/ (radio/schedules.json). The app looks up the current programme by converting the head-unit UTC time into the station's timezone, then matching days + start/end.
